title: A. saundersii 珠碧桑氏莲花掌

segments.t:
原文来自ICN
翻译：杂交赵一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。SAUNDERSII Bolle, 1859
Synonyms :
Sempervivum saundersii (Bolle) Christ (1888)
Aldasorea saundersii (Bolle) hort. ex Haage & Schmidt (1930)异名：
Sempervivum saundersii (Bolle) Christ (1888)
Aldasorea saundersii (Bolle) hort. ex Haage & Schmidt (1930)
Section Chrysocome
Distribution : Canary Islands (Gomera); ± 150 – 800 m.
Chrysocome系列
分布：加纳利群岛（戈梅拉岛）；海拔150米到800米。Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
形态描述（根据2003版IHSP）Perennial, densely branched shrublets to 30 cm, with distinct pleasant scent.
多年生植物,可长成株型30cm的多分枝小灌木,具有独特的芳香。Branches 1 - 4 mm in diameter, glabrate, slightly viscid, ± smooth.
枝干1 - 4毫米直径，无毛，稍黏，光滑或毛糙。Rosette 2.5 - 6 cm in diameter, flattish, inner leaves ± erect, imbricate and forming a globose bud during the dry season.
莲座直径2.5 - 6厘米，扁平，生长点周边叶可能直立，叶片覆瓦状排列。在干燥的季节会包裹成一个球状。Leaves 1.2 - 3.5 x 0.7 - 1.3 cm, 1.5 - 2.5 mm thick, elliptic to obovate, apically acute or rounded, retuse, cuneate or attenuate, pubescent, green to yellow-green, lower face reddish variegated.
叶1.2－3.5厘米长，0.7－1.3厘米宽，1.5 - 2.5 mm厚，椭圆形到倒卵形，顶部锐尖或圆润，微凹，楔形或渐狭。具短柔毛，绿色到黄绿色，叶背面有红斑。Inflorescences lax, 3 - 8 x 2 - 15 cm, 5- to 70-flowered, peduncle 3 - 8 cm, pedicels 3 - 12 mm, puberulent.
花序排列疏松，3～8×2 - 15厘米，有5到70朵花，花序梗3—8厘米高，花梗3 - 12毫米，被细小的绒毛。Flowers 12- to 16-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 6 - 9 x 1.5 - 2.5 mm, oblanceolate, acuminate, yellow, filaments glabrous.
花12～16瓣，萼片被微柔毛，花瓣6～9×1.5 - 2.5毫米，披针形，渐尖，黄色，花丝无毛。Cytology : 2n=36
细胞学检查：2n（2倍体）＝36Aeonium saundersii La Gomera :
戈梅拉岛上的桑氏莲花掌
